component.name: LibertyX Player
component.summary: Your videos and your home server, with frame-accurate seeking
Seus vídeos e o servidor de casa, com rolagem quadro a quadro
Tus videos y el servidor de casa, con búsqueda fotograma a fotograma

description.p: The LibertyX Player from Android and iPhone, on the desktop: a library of your video folders with covers and "continue watching", a player with frame-accurate seeking by dragging the video, subtitles and audio tracks, and network folders (SMB) played straight from your PC or NAS without copying.

O LibertyX Player do Android e do iPhone, no desktop: biblioteca das pastas de vídeo com capas e "continuar assistindo", player com rolagem quadro a quadro arrastando o vídeo, legendas e faixas de áudio, e pastas da rede (SMB) tocadas direto do PC ou do NAS, sem copiar.
